replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: I have a complicated relationship with math. It's not my favorite subject, and I often struggle with it, especially abstract concepts. However, I appreciate its practical applications in chemistry, which I enjoy. My parents, with advanced degrees, always encouraged me, but I still find it challenging.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, I often feel anxious when facing math problems. The fear of making mistakes and not understanding concepts quickly makes me stressed. Despite my high openness to new ideas, math's rigid rules make me uneasy. My neuroticism doesn't help either—I overthink and doubt my abilities.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried using an AI tutor for math last year. It helped explain concepts step-by-step, which was useful, but the abstract parts still confused me. The experience was okay, but I prefer learning from books or people, as AI lacks a personal touch. My low extraversion means I avoid interacting much with AI.

replies.According to you, how can LLMs be used t: LLMs can personalize learning by adapting to students' paces, like explaining concepts multiple ways.
